name: zgeometry_vec3_snap_point_to_segment_xy_if_near
description: zGeometry_Vec3::SnapPointToSegmentXYIfNear snaps a test point to a nearby XY segment when it lies within tolerance and between segment endpoints.
known_limits: Binary Ninja renders the x87 comparison/projection math as low-level floating-point flag logic. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry model source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x469e90 validates the vertical, horizontal, and general XY segment paths, including open-interval endpoint checks and snapping only X, only Y, or both XY coordinates as appropriate.
The native polygon snap smoke verifies vertical, horizontal, diagonal, and out-of-segment cases while preserving Z.
